hooks.command: s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/altharness/alt-harness"; [ -x "$s" ] || { echo "adr_preflight_disabled: $s not found in this checkout; code edits are not gated."; exit 0; }; "$s" preflight --hook

s="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/altharness/alt-harness"; [ -x "$s" ] || { echo "agent_harness_selfcheck_disabled: $s not found in this checkout; the protected-path and event-time edit guards are not active."; exit 0; }; "$s" selfcheck --hook

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "$(dirname "$f")" || exit 0; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" ;; *.py) uv run --no-sync ruff format --quiet "$f" ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.svelte) npx --no-install biome format --write "$f" ;; esac >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; f_abs=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && printf '%s/%s' "$(pwd -P)" "$(basename "$f")") || exit 0; case "$f_abs" in */docs/ADR/*.md) command -v docdag >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f_abs")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"); out=$(cd "$root" && docdag validate --touching "$f_abs" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; */docdag.yaml) command -v docdag >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f_abs")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"); out=$(cd "$root" && docdag lint --strict --config "$f_abs" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(^|[[:space:]&;|`(]|\$\()(git([[:space:]]+-[cC][[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]]+(repo[[:space:]]+sync|release[[:space:]]+(upload|create)|pr[[:space:]]+(create|merge)|workflow[[:space:]]+run|run[[:space:]]+rerun)|git[[:space:]]+remote[[:space:]]+(update|set-url|add)|git[[:space:]]+fetch[[:space:]]+.*push)([[:space:]]|$|;|&|\||`|\))'; then printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"BLOCKED: git/gh push-class commands are forbidden by user policy. Ask the user to run push manually."}}'; exit 2; fi
